title: Drita topple Prizreni to clinch Liga e pare title
description: Drita - Prizreni 92-91 Great defensive blocking was one of the keys in this match when Drita made 7 blocks. 25 personal fouls committed by Prizreni helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. The best player for the winners was Adrian Ibishi who had a double-double by scoring 18 points, 12 rebounds and 4 assists (on 7-of-8 shooting from the field). American guard Jarvis Walker (190, college: IUPUI) chipped in 20 points and 9 rebounds. Rron Dahsyla (193-2005) produced 23 points, 7 rebounds, 9 assists and 4 steals and forward Qendrim Ajazaj (193-1995) added 21 points, 10 rebounds and 4 assists respectively for the guests. Both teams had five players each who scored in double figures.
imageCaption: Drita topple Prizreni to clinch Liga e pare title (Photo: FBK)

title: Grapeland win Liga e Pare 2024-2025 season!
description: Grapeland have won Liga e Pare 2024-2025 season. They won the Finals against KEKU with a final 75-69 win. Bardh Rexha (191-G-2001) led the way with 20 points and Khari Broadway (185-G, college: Minot St.) had 18. Burim Zekiqi (200-G/F-1997, agency: BIG) and Kujtim Ujkani (201-F-1998) followed them with 9 points each in a win. Donat Rexhepi (195-G/F-2002, agency: BIG) replied with 26 points in the losing effort.
imageCaption: Grapeland win Liga e Pare 2024-2025 season! (Photo: telegrafi.com)

title: KB Istogu win Liga e Pare 2022-2023 season
description: KB Istogu have won Liga e Pare 2022-2023 season as they swept the Final series against Bora 2-0. At first KB Istogu celebrated a 94-81 win and then posted an 85-74 victory. Mirlind Zekaj (196-F/G-2001) top-scored for the winners with 22 points and Arian Azemi (188-G) netted 19. Orges Shatri (194-F-2005) scored 14 and Labinot Kelmendi brought 11. Olsi Kurtaj (195-G-2004) replied with 14 points in the losing effort.
imageCaption: KB Istogu win Liga e Pare 2022-2023 season (Photo: Liga e Pare)

title: KB Vellaznimi win Liga e Pare
description: KB Vellaznimi have won Liga e Pare and would return to the SuperLeague for the next season. In the Final game they edged Prishtina e Re 76-65. Michael Green (190-G, college: MVSU) led the way with 33 points and Bardh Rexha (191-G-2001) netted 12. Ujkan Karanezi (202-SF-1995) posted 11, whilst Atik Koshi (189-G-1999) had 9. Dion Haxhosaj (206-C/F-1998) replied with 24 points in a loss and Arti Islamaj (G/F) produced 13.

title: RC Cola Drita celebrate Liga e Pare title
description: RC Cola Drita celebrated Liga e Pare title. They overcame Istogu in the Finals. RC Cola Drita earned a 92-74 victory in Game 2. They then went on the road and claimed a well-deserved 84-65 to capture the trophy. RC Cola Drita dominated in the regular season as well claiming 17 wins in 18 games played.
imageCaption: RC Cola Drita celebrate Liga e Pare title (Photo: facebook.com/KB Drita)
